name: epaper29_ssd1680
title: WeAct 2.9-inch e-paper of black, white and red
description: A 2.9-inch e-paper of three colours, 128x296, on an SSD1680: SPI with D/C, RES and BUSY on eight holes and a 1.25 mm socket; a regulator takes 3.3 to 5 V, the lines are of 3.3 V
notes: SB1 and SB2 on the back choose four-wire SPI with D/C or three-wire; SB4 and SB5 the regulator, SB3 VCC straight to 3.3 V. The lines go through 100 ohm, with no pull-ups.
The glass changes in about 20 s and keeps its picture with no power: the program sends a picture by dgx_ssd1680_refresh().

power.name: VCC
power.why: 3.3 to 5 V through U1 with SB4 and SB5 closed, as on this module; 3.3 V only with SB3 instead.

J2.type: Wafer 1.25 mm socket, 8 pins, on the back

front.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

back.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13
photo.notes: The back: BUSY RES D/C CS SCL SDA GND VCC beside the holes, 1 and 2 in the top row, and beside the socket from 1 to 8; VCC: 3.3-5V (SB4+SB5), VCC: 3.3V Only (SB3), I/O: 3.3V. SB4, SB5 and 4-Lines SPI look closed, SB3 and 3-Lines SPI open.

schematic.source: WeAct Studio, Hardware/WeAct-EpaperModule-2.13_2.9 SchDoc.pdf, V1.0 of 2025-11-15, in github.com/WeActStudio/WeActStudio.EpaperModule: P1 and J2 from BUSY at 1 to VDD at 8, U1 ME6231A33 behind SB5 and SB4, SB3 around it, every line through 100 ohm, BS by SB1 to ground or SB2 to 3.3 V

glass.source: Yingruida YRD0290RWS800F6 V2.4, the glass WeAct gives for its 2.9-inch module of three colours in Doc/ of the same repository: 128x296, active area 29.06 x 66.90 mm, an SSD1680Z8. What glass this module has is not printed on it.

trial.source: examples/ssd1680_demo of DGX 0.10.17 on SPI3 of an ESP32 at 10 MHz: BUSY 4, RES 16, D/C 17, CS 5, SCL 18, SDA 23, VCC 3.3 V; seen right in all eight orientations and in landscape with its pins on the right, a change in 19.4 s
